traditions.WLC: מַשְׂכִּ֗יל לְ אָ֫סָ֥ף
traditions.LXX: Συνέσεως τῷ Ἀσάφ .
traditions.VUL: Intelléctus Asaph .
traditions.KJV: Maschil of Asaph .

1.english_reference: O God, why hast thou cast [ us ] off for ever ?

traditions.WLC: לָ מָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים זָנַ֣חְתָּ לָ נֶ֑צַח
traditions.LXX: Ἵνα τί ἀπώσω , ὁ θεός , εἰς τέλος ;
traditions.VUL: Ut quid Deus repulísti in finem :
traditions.KJV: O God , why hast thou cast [ us ] off for ever ? [ why ]

1.english_reference: [ why ] doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture ?

traditions.WLC: יֶעְשַׁ֥ן אַ֝פְּ ךָ֗ בְּ צֹ֣אן מַרְעִיתֶֽ ךָ
traditions.LXX: ὠργίσθη ὁ θυμός σου ἐπὶ πρόβατα νομῆς σου ;
traditions.VUL: irátus est furor tuus super oves páscuæ tuæ ?
traditions.KJV: doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture ?

2.english_reference: Remember thy congregation , [ which ] thou hast purchased of old

traditions.WLC: זְכֹ֤ר עֲדָתְ ךָ֨ קָ֘נִ֤יתָ קֶּ֗דֶם
traditions.LXX: μνήσθητι τῆς συναγωγῆς σου ἧς ἐκτήσω ἀπ᾽ ἀρχῆς ·
traditions.VUL: Memor esto congregatiónis tuæ , quam possedísti ab inítio .
traditions.KJV: Remember thy congregation , [ which ] thou hast purchased of old ;

2.english_reference: the rod of thine inheritance , [ which ] thou hast redeemed

traditions.WLC: גָּ֭אַלְתָּ שֵׁ֣בֶט נַחֲלָתֶ֑ ךָ
traditions.LXX: ἐλυτρώσω ῥάβδον κληρονομίας σου ,
traditions.VUL: Redemísti virgam hereditátis tuæ :
traditions.KJV: the rod of thine inheritance , [ which ] thou hast redeemed ;

2.english_reference: this mount Zion , wherein thou hast dwelt

traditions.WLC: הַר צִ֝יּ֗וֹן זֶ֤ה שָׁכַ֬נְתָּ בּֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: ὄρος Σιὼν τοῦτο ὃ κατεσκήνωσας ἐν αὐτῷ .
traditions.VUL: mons Sion , in quo habitásti in eo .
traditions.KJV: this mount Zion , wherein thou hast dwelt .

3.english_reference: Lift up thy feet unto the perpetual desolations

traditions.WLC: הָרִ֣ימָ ה פְ֭עָמֶי ךָ לְ מַשֻּׁא֣וֹת נֶ֑צַח
traditions.LXX: ἔπαρον τὰς χεῖράς σου ἐπὶ τὰς ὑπερηφανίας αὐτῶν εἰς τέλος ,
traditions.VUL: Leva manus tuas in supérbias eórum in finem :
traditions.KJV: Lift up thy feet unto the perpetual desolations ; [ even ]

3.english_reference: [ even ] all [ that ] the enemy hath done wickedly in the sanctuary

traditions.WLC: כָּל הֵרַ֖ע אוֹיֵ֣ב בַּ קֹּֽדֶשׁ
traditions.LXX: ὅσα ἐπονηρεύσατο ὁ ἐχθρὸς ἐν τοῖς ἁγίοις σου .
traditions.VUL: quanta malignátus est inimícus in sancto !
traditions.KJV: all [ that ] the enemy hath done wickedly in the sanctuary .

4.english_reference: Thine enemies roar in the midst of thy congregations

traditions.WLC: שָׁאֲג֣וּ צֹ֭רְרֶי ךָ בְּ קֶ֣רֶב מוֹעֲדֶ֑ ךָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐνεκαυχήσαντο οἱ μισοῦντές σε ἐν μέσῳ τῆς ἑορτῆς σου ,
traditions.VUL: Et gloriáti sunt qui odérunt te , in médio solemnitátis tuæ .
traditions.KJV: Thine enemies roar in the midst of thy congregations ;

4.english_reference: they set up their ensigns [ for ] signs

traditions.WLC: שָׂ֖מוּ אוֹתֹתָ֣ ם אֹתֽוֹת
traditions.VUL: Posuérunt signa sua , signa :
traditions.KJV: they set up their ensigns [ for ] signs .

5.english_reference: [ A man ] was famous according as he had lifted up axes upon the thick trees

traditions.WLC: יִ֭וָּדַע כְּ מֵבִ֣יא לְ מָ֑עְלָ ה בִּֽ סֲבָךְ עֵ֝֗ץ קַרְדֻּמּֽוֹת
traditions.LXX: ὡς εἰς τὴν εἴσοδον ὑπεράνω · ὡς ἐν δρυμῷ ξύλων ἀξίναις ἐξέκοψαν
traditions.VUL: et non cognovérunt sicut in éxitu super summum . Quasi in silva lignórum secúribus
traditions.KJV: [ A man ] was famous according as he had lifted up axes upon the thick trees .

6.english_reference: But now they break down the carved work thereof at once with axes and hammers

traditions.WLC: ו עת פִּתּוּחֶ֣י הָ יָּ֑חַד בְּ כַשִּׁ֥יל וְ֝ כֵֽילַפֹּ֗ת יַהֲלֹמֽוּ ן
traditions.LXX: τὰς θύρας αὐτῆς · ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ ἐν πελέκει καὶ λαξευτηρίῳ κατέρραξαν αὐτήν .
traditions.VUL: excidérunt iánuas eius in idípsum : in secúri , et áscia deiecérunt eam .
traditions.KJV: But now they break down the carved work thereof at once with axes and hammers .

7.english_reference: They have cast fire into thy sanctuary

traditions.WLC: שִׁלְח֣וּ בָ֭ אֵשׁ מִקְדָּשֶׁ֑ ךָ
traditions.LXX: ἐνεπύρισαν ἐν πυρὶ τὸ ἁγιαστήριόν σου ·
traditions.VUL: Incendérunt igni sanctuárium tuum :
traditions.KJV: They have cast fire into thy sanctuary ,

7.english_reference: they have defiled [ by casting down ] the dwelling place of thy name to the ground

traditions.WLC: לָ֝ אָ֗רֶץ חִלְּל֥וּ מִֽשְׁכַּן שְׁמֶֽ ךָ
traditions.LXX: εἰς τὴν γῆν ἐβεβήλωσαν τὸ σκήνωμα τοῦ ὀνόματός σου .
traditions.VUL: in terra polluérunt tabernáculum nóminis tui .
traditions.KJV: they have defiled [ by casting down ] the dwelling place of thy name to the ground .

8.english_reference: They said in their hearts , Let us destroy them together

traditions.WLC: אָמְר֣וּ בְ֭ לִבָּ ם נִינָ֣ ם יָ֑חַד
traditions.LXX: εἶπαν ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτῶν ἡ συγγενία αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό Δεῦτε καὶ καταπαύσωμεν
traditions.VUL: Dixérunt in corde suo cognátio eórum simul : Quiéscere faciámus
traditions.KJV: They said in their hearts , Let us destroy them together :

8.english_reference: they have burned up all the synagogues of God in the land

traditions.WLC: שָׂרְפ֖וּ כָל מוֹעֲדֵי אֵ֣ל בָּ אָֽרֶץ
traditions.LXX: τὰς ἑορτὰς Κυρίου ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς .
traditions.VUL: omnes dies festos Dei a terra .
traditions.KJV: they have burned up all the synagogues of God in the land .

traditions.WLC: אֽוֹתֹתֵ֗י נוּ לֹ֥א רָ֫אִ֥ינוּ
traditions.LXX: τὰ σημεῖα ἡμῶν οὐκ εἴδομεν ,
traditions.VUL: Signa nostra non vídimus ,
traditions.KJV: We see not our signs : [ there is ]

9.english_reference: [ there is ] no more any prophet

traditions.WLC: אֵֽין ע֥וֹד נָבִ֑יא
traditions.LXX: οὐκ ἔστιν ἔτι προφήτης ,
traditions.VUL: iam non est prophéta :
traditions.KJV: no more any prophet :

9.english_reference: neither [ is there ] among us any that knoweth how long

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹֽא אִ֝תָּ֗ נוּ יֹדֵ֥עַ עַד מָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἡμᾶς οὐ γνώσεται ἔτι .
traditions.VUL: et nos non cognóscet ámplius .
traditions.KJV: neither [ is there ] among us any that knoweth how long .

10.english_reference: O God , how long shall the adversary reproach ?

traditions.WLC: עַד מָתַ֣י אֱ֭לֹהִים יְחָ֣רֶף צָ֑ר
traditions.LXX: ἕως πότε , ὁ θεός , ὀνειδιεῖ ὁ ἐχθρός ;
traditions.VUL: Usquequo Deus improperábit inimícus :
traditions.KJV: O God , how long shall the adversary reproach ?

10.english_reference: shall the enemy blaspheme thy name for ever ?

traditions.WLC: יְנָ֘אֵ֤ץ אוֹיֵ֖ב שִׁמְ ךָ֣ לָ נֶֽצַח
traditions.LXX: παροξυνεῖ ὁ ὑπεναντίος τὸ ὄνομά σου εἰς τέλος ;
traditions.VUL: irrítat adversárius nomen tuum in finem ?
traditions.KJV: shall the enemy blaspheme thy name for ever ?

11.english_reference: Why withdrawest thou thy hand , even thy right hand ?

traditions.WLC: לָ֤ מָּה תָשִׁ֣יב יָ֭דְ ךָ וִֽ ימִינֶ֑ ךָ
traditions.LXX: ἵνα τί ἀποστρέφεις τὴν χεῖρά σου καὶ τὴν δεξιάν σου
traditions.VUL: Ut quid avértis manum tuam , et déxteram tuam ,
traditions.KJV: Why withdrawest thou thy hand , even thy right hand ?

11.english_reference: pluck [ it ] out of thy bosom .

traditions.WLC: מִ קֶּ֖רֶב חוק ך כַלֵּֽה
traditions.LXX: ἐκ μέσου τοῦ κόλπου σου εἰς τέλος ;
traditions.VUL: de médio sinu tuo in finem ?
traditions.KJV: pluck [ it ] out of thy bosom .

12.english_reference: For God [ is ] my King of old ,

traditions.WLC: וֵ֭ אלֹהִים מַלְכִּ֣ י מִ קֶּ֑דֶם
traditions.LXX: ὁ δὲ βασιλεὺς ἡμῶν πρὸ αἰῶνος ,
traditions.VUL: Deus autem rex noster ante sǽcula :
traditions.KJV: For God [ is ] my King of old ,

12.english_reference: working salvation in the midst of the earth .

traditions.WLC: פֹּעֵ֥ל יְ֝שׁוּע֗וֹת בְּ קֶ֣רֶב הָ אָֽרֶץ
traditions.LXX: εἰργάσατο σωτηρίαν ἐν μέσῳ τῆς γῆς .
traditions.VUL: operátus est salútem in médio terræ .
traditions.KJV: working salvation in the midst of the earth .

13.english_reference: Thou didst divide the sea by thy strength :

traditions.WLC: אַתָּ֤ה פוֹרַ֣רְתָּ בְ עָזְּ ךָ֣ יָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: σὺ ἐκραταίωσας ἐν τῇ δυνάμει σου τὴν θάλασσαν ,
traditions.VUL: Tu confirmásti in virtúte tua mare :
traditions.KJV: Thou didst divide the sea by thy strength :

13.english_reference: thou brakest the heads of the dragons in the waters .

traditions.WLC: שִׁבַּ֖רְתָּ רָאשֵׁ֥י תַ֝נִּינִ֗ים עַל הַ מָּֽיִם
traditions.LXX: σὺ συνέτριψας τὰς κεφαλὰς τῶν δρακόντων ἐπὶ τοῦ ὕδατος ·
traditions.VUL: contribulásti cápita dracónum in aquis .
traditions.KJV: thou brakest the heads of the dragons in the waters .

14.english_reference: Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces ,

traditions.WLC: אַתָּ֣ה רִ֭צַּצְתָּ רָאשֵׁ֣י לִוְיָתָ֑ן
traditions.VUL: Tu confregísti cápita dracónis :
traditions.KJV: Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces , [ and ]

14.english_reference: [ and ] gavest him [ to be ] meat to the people inhabiting the wilderness .

traditions.WLC: תִּתְּנֶ֥ נּוּ מַ֝אֲכָ֗ל לְ עָ֣ם לְ צִיִּֽים
traditions.LXX: ἔδωκας αὐτὸν βρῶμα λαοῖς τοῖς Αἰθίοψιν .
traditions.VUL: dedísti eum escam pópulis Æthíopum .
traditions.KJV: gavest him [ to be ] meat to the people inhabiting the wilderness .

15.english_reference: Thou didst cleave the fountain and the flood :

traditions.WLC: אַתָּ֣ה בָ֭קַעְתָּ מַעְיָ֣ן וָ נָ֑חַל
traditions.LXX: σὺ διέρρηξας πηγὰς καὶ χειμάρρους ,
traditions.VUL: Tu dirupísti fontes et torréntes :
traditions.KJV: Thou didst cleave the fountain and the flood :

traditions.WLC: אַתָּ֥ה ה֝וֹבַ֗שְׁתָּ נַהֲר֥וֹת אֵיתָֽן
traditions.VUL: tu siccásti flúvios Ethan .
traditions.KJV: thou driedst up mighty rivers .

16.english_reference: The day [ is ] thine , the night also [ is ] thine :

traditions.WLC: לְ ךָ֣ י֭וֹם אַף לְ ךָ֥ לָ֑יְלָה
traditions.LXX: σή ἐστιν ἡ ἡμέρα , καὶ σή ἐστιν ἡ νύξ ·
traditions.VUL: Tuus est dies , et tua est nox :
traditions.KJV: The day [ is ] thine , the night also [ is ] thine :

16.english_reference: thou hast prepared the light and the sun .

traditions.WLC: אַתָּ֥ה הֲ֝כִינ֗וֹתָ מָא֥וֹר וָ שָֽׁמֶשׁ
traditions.LXX: σὺ κατηρτίσω ἥλιον καὶ σελήνην .
traditions.VUL: tu fabricátus es auróram et solem .
traditions.KJV: thou hast prepared the light and the sun .

17.english_reference: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth :

traditions.WLC: אַתָּ֣ה הִ֭צַּבְתָּ כָּל גְּבוּל֣וֹת אָ֑רֶץ
traditions.LXX: σὺ ἐποίησας πάντα τὰ ὅρια τῆς γῆς ·
traditions.VUL: Tu fecísti omnes términos terræ :
traditions.KJV: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth :

17.english_reference: thou hast made summer and winter .

traditions.WLC: קַ֥יִץ וָ֝ חֹ֗רֶף אַתָּ֥ה יְצַרְתָּ ם
traditions.LXX: θέρος καὶ ἔαρ σὺ ἐποίησας ·
traditions.VUL: æstátem et ver plasmásti ea .
traditions.KJV: thou hast made summer and winter .

traditions.WLC: זְכָר זֹ֗את
traditions.LXX: μνήσθητι ταύτης τῆς κτίσεώς σου .
traditions.VUL: Memor esto huius ,
traditions.KJV: Remember this , [ that ]

18.english_reference: [ that ] the enemy hath reproached , O LORD ,

traditions.WLC: א֭וֹיֵב חֵרֵ֣ף יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: ἐχθρὸς ὠνείδισεν τὸν κύριον ,
traditions.VUL: inimícus improperávit Dómino :
traditions.KJV: the enemy hath reproached , O LORD ,

18.english_reference: and [ that ] the foolish people have blasphemed thy name .

traditions.WLC: וְ עַ֥ם נָ֝בָ֗ל נִֽאֲצ֥וּ שְׁמֶֽ ךָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ λαὸς ἄφρων παρώξυνεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: et pópulus insípiens incitávit nomen tuum .
traditions.KJV: and [ that ] the foolish people have blasphemed thy name .

19.english_reference: O deliver not the soul of thy turtledove unto the multitude [ of the wicked ] :

traditions.WLC: אַל תִּתֵּ֣ן לְ֭ חַיַּת נֶ֣פֶשׁ תּוֹרֶ֑ ךָ
traditions.LXX: μὴ παραδῷς τοῖς θηρίοις ψυχὴν ἐξομολογουμένην σοι ,
traditions.VUL: Ne tradas béstiis ánimas confiténtes tibi ,
traditions.KJV: O deliver not the soul of thy turtledove unto the multitude [ of the wicked ] :

19.english_reference: forget not the congregation of thy poor for ever .

traditions.WLC: חַיַּ֥ת עֲ֝נִיֶּ֗י ךָ אַל תִּשְׁכַּ֥ח לָ נֶֽצַח
traditions.LXX: τῶν ψυχῶν τῶν πενήτων σου μὴ ἐπιλάθῃ εἰς τέλος .
traditions.VUL: et ánimas páuperum tuórum ne obliviscáris in finem .
traditions.KJV: forget not the congregation of thy poor for ever .

traditions.WLC: הַבֵּ֥ט לַ בְּרִ֑ית
traditions.LXX: ἐπίβλεψον εἰς τὴν διαθήκην σου ,
traditions.VUL: Réspice in testaméntum tuum :
traditions.KJV: Have respect unto the covenant :

20.english_reference: for the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruelty .

traditions.WLC: כִּ֥י מָלְא֥וּ מַחֲשַׁכֵּי אֶ֝֗רֶץ נְא֣וֹת חָמָֽס
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἐπληρώθησαν οἱ ἐσκοτωμένοι τῆς γῆς οἴκων ἀνομιῶν .
traditions.VUL: quia repléti sunt , qui obscuráti sunt terræ dómibus iniquitátum .
traditions.KJV: for the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruelty .

21.english_reference: O let not the oppressed return ashamed

traditions.WLC: אַל יָשֹׁ֣ב דַּ֣ךְ נִכְלָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: μὴ ἀποστραφήτω τεταπεινωμένος καὶ κατῃσχυμμένος ·
traditions.VUL: Ne avertátur húmilis factus confúsus :
traditions.KJV: O let not the oppressed return ashamed :

21.english_reference: let the poor and needy praise thy name

traditions.WLC: עָנִ֥י וְ֝ אֶבְי֗וֹן יְֽהַלְל֥וּ שְׁמֶֽ ךָ
traditions.LXX: πτωχὸς καὶ πένης αἰνέσουσιν τὸ ὄνομά σου .
traditions.VUL: pauper et inops laudábunt nomen tuum .
traditions.KJV: let the poor and needy praise thy name .

traditions.WLC: קוּמָ֣ ה אֱ֭לֹהִים
traditions.LXX: ἀνάστα , ὁ θεός ,
traditions.VUL: Exsúrge Deus ,
traditions.KJV: Arise , O God ,

traditions.WLC: רִיבָ֣ ה רִיבֶ֑ ךָ
traditions.LXX: δίκασον τὴν δίκην σου ·
traditions.VUL: iúdica causam tuam :
traditions.KJV: plead thine own cause :

22.english_reference: remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee daily

traditions.WLC: זְכֹ֥ר חֶרְפָּתְ ךָ֥ מִנִּי נָ֝בָ֗ל כָּל הַ יּֽוֹם
traditions.LXX: μνήσθητι τῶν ὀνειδισμῶν σου τῶν ὑπὸ ἄφρονος ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν .
traditions.VUL: memor esto improperiórum tuórum , eórum quæ ab insipiénte sunt tota die .
traditions.KJV: remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee daily .

23.english_reference: Forget not the voice of thine enemies

traditions.WLC: אַל תִּ֭שְׁכַּח ק֣וֹל צֹרְרֶ֑י ךָ
traditions.LXX: μὴ ἐπιλάθῃ τῆς φωνῆς τῶν ἱκετῶν σου ,
traditions.VUL: Ne obliviscáris voces inimicórum tuórum :
traditions.KJV: Forget not the voice of thine enemies :

23.english_reference: the tumult of those that rise up against thee increaseth continually

traditions.WLC: שְׁא֥וֹן קָ֝מֶ֗י ךָ עֹלֶ֥ה תָמִֽיד
traditions.LXX: ἡ ὑπερηφανία τῶν μισούντων σε ἀναβαίη διὰ παντὸς πρὸς σέ .
traditions.VUL: supérbia eórum , qui te odérunt , ascéndit semper .
traditions.KJV: the tumult of those that rise up against thee increaseth continually .
